entities.summary: Verron Ulric Haynes is a Trinidadian-born former American football running back. He was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the fifth round of the 2002 NFL draft, following three successful college football seasons at the University of Georgia. With the Steelers, he won Super Bowl XL.
